description.value:
Duration constant

Dead flesh still takes a graft under your hands, if you know how to feed it. You may install bio-augments into your Afflicted using the ordinary bio-augment rules, treating each Afflicted as a willing patient regardless of what it was willing to in life. An Afflicted's Load and Resonance are tracked individually, same as any creature's, and both are lost when it collapses along with everything grafted into it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Afflicted is this class's minion subsystem: a raise-cap, a collapse timer, and (at level 18) a shared cross-actor Resonance pool. pf2e's schema has no generic "max controlled minions" field, no "minion lifespan" field, and no mechanism for one actor's rule element to modify a different actor's stats on an ongoing basis. No rule element grants "you may install items into a different creature," and augment Load/Resonance tracking on a minion actor has no cross-actor mechanism (same absence class as MINION-COMMAND/P-CROSSCREATURE).
